title: CI: build; unit test and lint on every push and PR

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The workflow uses `actions/checkout@v3` and runs only on `push`. It runs `build` and then `test`, which is redundant. It uploads no reports, and it has no lint gate.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - None. The workflow itself is the test.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Trigger on `push` and `pull_request`, and add `actions/checkout@v4`.
2. Keep `actions/setup-java@v4` (temurin 17) and add `gradle/actions/setup-gradle` for caching. It's Apache-2.0 and a GitHub Action, not an app dependency.
3. Run a single step: `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`.
4. Upload `app/build/reports/**` on failure.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Push to `main`. The workflow is green and lint runs.
